primary_endpoint: Participants with AEs/SAEs through Day 112 and change from baseline in ALT at Day 84 (Week 12).
efficacy_outcome: ALT outcome values were 67.215 (100 mg), 48.114 (50 mg), and 59.544 (placebo); additional reported values were 0.667, 0.702, and 0.901, respectively. Reported ANCOVA p-values were 0.7489, 0.0005, and 0.0005; the registry summary does not clearly map these p-values to treatment comparisons.
safety_signal: Participants with AEs: 35 (LMB763 100 mg), 37 (50 mg), and 33 (placebo); with SAEs: 2/37, 3/44, and 0/40, respectively. No deaths were reported.
